exact_replacements.new:
Let γ be the probability of the better region. The marginal setting density is p(x)=γl(x)+(1−γ)g(x). Here the paper's improvement threshold is y*, rather than necessarily the best observed c used in the preceding example. Its factorization treats p(x|y) as the same l(x) throughout y<y*. Bayes' rule then gives

\[
\begin{aligned}
\operatorname{EI}_{y^*}(x)
&=\int_{-\infty}^{y^*}(y^*-y)p(y\mid x)\,dy\\
&=\frac{l(x)}{p(x)}\int_{-\infty}^{y^*}(y^*-y)p(y)\,dy.
\end{aligned}
\]
